name: pixel-quota-left
description: One pixel-art tree per AI coding plan (Claude, Codex). Leaves on the tree = quota left.

quotaLeft.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often plan usage is fetched from the providers.

quotaLeft.claude.enabled.description: Show a tree for your Claude plan (reads the Claude Code login token and queries api.anthropic.com).

quotaLeft.codex.enabled.description: Show a tree for your ChatGPT/Codex plan (reads the Codex login token and queries chatgpt.com).

quotaLeft.claude.configDir.description: Claude config dir containing .credentials.json. Default: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

quotaLeft.codex.home.description: Codex home containing auth.json and sessions/. Default: $CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.
